notes.title: Devlog #1: Unveiling "Legends of the Eternal Flame"!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to embark on this journey with you as we unveil of our epic 2D platformer adventure, where you, the child of the Eternal Flame named Lapalapa, will rise to the challenge of saving the world from the clutches of evil.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020047/a6109b7724db4a92c1ad6e5a916a07a465f1b3ba.png

The Premise:

An ancient evil has awakened from its slumber, threatening to plunge the realm into eternal chaos. As a child of the Eternal Flame, it's up to you to harness your courage, skill, and determination to thwart the malevolent forces and restore balance to the land.

The Hero's Journey:

In "Legends of the Eternal Flame" players will assume the role of Lapalapa on a perilous quest to vanquish the darkness threatening to consume the world. You will traverse treacherous landscapes, collect fragments of the Eternal Flame and finally try to reach the Eternal Torch and light the fires within, banishing the ancient evil.

Dive into a richly detailed world teeming with diverse environments, from lush forests and towering mountains to desolate wastelands and haunted caves. Experience fast-paced, adrenaline-pumping action as you navigate intricate platforming challenges nad try to avoid treacherous traps.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020047/bcd71678cd22a269f0ca82e54ed346b135fc5ae6.png

Join the Adventure:

Are you ready to embark on a legendary quest to save the world from darkness? "Legends of the Eternal Flame" awaits, beckoning brave adventurers like yourself to rise to the challenge and become the hero the world needs.

Prepare to experience an unforgettable journey filled with danger, excitement, and triumph as you embark on the adventure of a lifetime. The fate of the world hangs in the balance - will you answer the call?

Thank you for joining us on this extraordinary adventure. Together, let's rise against the darkness and become the legends we were always meant to be!

And don't forget to check our game on Steamdeck!

We wanted to introduce you to our new title, which will be available on Steam Deck from May 29, 2024!:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2958170/Switch_Range/?curator_clanid=39179691

Ask questions and share ideas on our discord community:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020047/725a977bc01b92ca5fc82d22a8c193865fd02d4f.png
